heading: About Rollercoaster.dev
intro: Rollercoaster.dev is a toolkit by and for neurodivergent minds, rethinking how we track progress, set goals, and celebrate our journeys.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: We build neuro-centered tools—rooted in neurodivergent lived experience—to empower flexible, self-paced learning and growth. Traditional productivity apps assume linear progress and fixed schedules. We don't. (Spoiler: neither do our brains!)

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.content: A community-led team of designers, developers, and neurodivergent collaborators building better digital tools.

flexibility.name: Flexibility
flexibility.description: Support for ebbs, flows, and rest without judgment.

clarity.name: Clarity
clarity.description: Clear visual feedback, simple UI, optional deeper info.

community.name: Community
community.description: Shared journeys, mutual support, lived experience at the center.

benefits.title: How You Benefit
benefits.item1: Set goals that fit your rhythm. No rigid schedules or fixed timelines.
benefits.item2: Document achievements with Open Badges—digital credentials that prove your skills and stay with you forever.
benefits.item3: Visualize your growth in ways that work for you. Choose from multiple view options.
benefits.item4: Connect with others who understand the journey. Built by and for neurodivergent people.
